title: Bishop McIntyre at Edwards AFB in 1954 during rumoured Eisenhower alien deal

tellings.quote: This is not even MJ-12. This is real records of this Bishop McIntyre hiring hanging around Edwards Air Force Base in '54 when you know, Eisenhower is rumored to you know, do his deal with the aliens

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there are real records of a churchman known as Bishop McIntyre spending time at Edwards Air Force Base in California in 1954. Michels points out that this is the same year President Dwight Eisenhower is rumoured to have made a secret deal with aliens. He adds that this comes from real records and not from MJ-12, a set of papers said to describe a secret group of officials handling UFO matters. If true, the bishop's visit would hint that a churchman was brought in around the time of that rumoured deal.
